about: The texts whose scan is a modern edition: its own matter (preface, introduction, notes, its editor's translation, typed 'frontmatter') stays on the desk; scripts/corpus_sync.py sends such a passage with its place and type only. The Sanskrit is sent as before: whether an edition's Sanskrit may be shown is decided apart. Set withhold_frontmatter to false to send a text's own matter again. Facts below are read from each scan's own title pages (docs/REPAIR_AND_SOURCES_2026-10-28.md).

HAYASHIRSHA_PANCARATRA.edition: Hayasirsapancaratra (Adi-kanda), ed. Kali Kumar Dutta Sastri, iconographical notes by Kalyan Kumar Dasgupta, Bibliotheca Indica Work 306, The Asiatic Society, Calcutta, 1976
HAYASHIRSHA_PANCARATRA.evidence: the scan's page 4: 'Work Number-306, (c) The Asiatic Society, First Published in 1976'

Karan_Aagama_by_Prof_Rama_Chandra_Pandey.edition: Karanagama (Kriyapada), with Hindi translation and notes, ed. Prof. Ramachandra Pandey, Shaiva Bharati Shodha Pratishthanam, Jangamawadi Math, Varanasi, 1994 (Research Publications Series 4)
Karan_Aagama_by_Prof_Rama_Chandra_Pandey.evidence: the scan's page 4: '(c) Shaiva Bharati Shodha Pratishthanam, first edition 1994'

Ganita_Yukti_Bhasa_of_Jyesthadeva_Sarma_.edition: Ganitayuktibhasa of Jyesthadeva, the Sanskrit version, ed. Vachaspati K. V. Sarma, vol. III, Indian Institute of Advanced Study, Shimla, 2004
Ganita_Yukti_Bhasa_of_Jyesthadeva_Sarma_.notice: (c) Indian Institute of Advanced Study, Shimla, 2004, all rights reserved
Ganita_Yukti_Bhasa_of_Jyesthadeva_Sarma_.evidence: the scan's pages 3 and 6: 'First published 2004, (c) Indian Institute of Advanced Study, Shimla, All rights reserved'

Mallapurana.edition: Mallapurana, ed. B. J. Sandesara and R. N. Mehta, Gaekwad's Oriental Series 144, M. S. University of Baroda, 1964
Mallapurana.evidence: the scan's pages 1 to 3: GOS No. 144, first edition, 500 copies; no notice read

AkashBhairavaKalpam.edition: Akasa-bhairava-kalpa with a short Hindi commentary by Kaviraj Pt. Nanakachandra Sharma
AkashBhairavaKalpam.notice: a modern Hindi commentary, in copyright
AkashBhairavaKalpam.evidence: the scan's page 3: 'samksipta-hindi-vyakhyopetam, vyakhyakara Kaviraj Pt. Nanakachandra Sharma'

Astadhyayi.edition: Astadhyayisutrapatha with anuvrtti, vartika and paribhasa, ed. Brahmacarini Medha Michika, Arsha Vidya Gurukulam, Anaikatti; Arsha Avinash Foundation, Coimbatore, Vikrama Samvat 2070 (2013)
Astadhyayi.evidence: the scan's pages 1 and 2; no notice read
